LESSON: PRECAUTIONS WHEN USING

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Environment and 1.7 Energy: Light By the end of the sub-strand, the  Learners t
Topic 1.7.3: Precautions when using

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Precautions when using. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: which light the eyes (reading in dim light, harm us?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify practices in which light energy could harm eyes
2. take safety measure against harmful light energy to reduce risk to self and others
3. appreciate safety precautions when using light energy. others from harmful light energy awareness of harmful effects of light energy harmful effects of light and safety precautions. 90

1. identify practices in which light energy could harm eyes

2. take safety measure against harmful light energy to reduce risk to self and others
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to take safety measure against harmful light energy to reduce risk to self and others. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate safety precautions when using light energy. others from harmful light energy awareness of harmful effects of light energy harmful effects of light and safety precautions. 90

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Precautions when using.
2. Explain Precautions when using to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Precautions when using.
4. Show that you can: identify practices in which light energy could harm eyes
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Precautions when using. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: which light the eyes (reading in dim light, harm us?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. identify practices in which light energy could harm eyes
2. take safety measure against harmful light energy to reduce risk to self and others
3. appreciate safety precautions when using light energy. others from harmful light energy awareness of harmful effects of light energy harmful effects of light and safety precautions. 90
